title: BrewPi Ferment Reading Beer Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewpi:ferment beer_temp_c=*
| stats sum(beer_temp_c) as total_value, avg(beer_temp_c) as avg_value by beer_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks beer values by total and average beer temperature across BrewPi ferment reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `beer_temp_c` values for each BrewPi ferment reading event and review total and average beer temperature by beer.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total beer temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly which beer shows the biggest beer temperature numbers in your BrewPi ferment reading data.
